system.description:
When damage would send you to Death's Door or kill you, roll a Grit Check with CR equal to the number of Adrenaline Rush Checks made this Doom Cycle. On a success you are left on 1 Health Point instead.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.36
system.summary: When damage would send you to Death's Door or kill you, roll a Grit Check with CR equal to the number of Adrenaline Rush Checks made this Doom Cycle. On a success you are left on 1 Health Point instead.

automation.label: Adrenaline Rush (CR = checks this Doom Cycle)
automation.onSuccess: You are left on 1 Health Point instead.

automation.note: Roll this after the damage takes you to 0 HP. Keep a count of Adrenaline Rush Checks this Doom Cycle, including this one, and use it as the CR, so the first is CR 1 and the second CR 2. The count resets when a new Doom Cycle starts. The 1 Health Point is set even if you are Cursed.
